title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
summary: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.
title_en: OpenAI to Watermark ChatGPT Text in the EU
title_zh: OpenAI将在欧盟为ChatGPT文本添加水印
summary_en: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. The company notes that editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect.
summary_zh: 为遵守欧盟《人工智能法案》，OpenAI将在欧盟为ChatGPT和Codex生成的文本添加水印，并指出编辑可能使隐形标记更难被检测。

title: AI researcher warns 'we are racing to build and grow our own adversary' in NYC hearing
summary: The leading AI labs facing intensifying scrutiny over their safety and security practices.
title_en: AI researcher warns 'we are racing to build and grow our own adversary' in NYC hearing
title_zh: AI研究员在纽约听证会上警告：我们正在竞相打造并壮大自己的对手
summary_en: At a New York City hearing, a leading AI researcher warned that labs are racing to build and grow their own adversary, as major AI companies face intensifying scrutiny over safety and security practices.
summary_zh: 在纽约市一场听证会上，一位顶尖AI研究员警告称，各实验室正竞相打造并壮大自己的对手，主要AI公司因安全与安保实践面临日益严格的审查。

title: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
summary: This past year, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other labs have announced breakthroughs on numerous long-standing mathematical problems, in some cases pushing well beyond what researchers expected current systems to be capable of — including resolving one of the famous Millennium Prize problems. But in classic Silicon Valley style, AI labs are moving fast and breaking things, […]
title_en: AI's Rapid Advance in Mathematics Sparks Drama and Debate
title_zh: AI在数学领域的快速进展引发争议与戏剧性事件
summary_en: AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic have made unexpected breakthroughs in long-standing math problems, including a Millennium Prize problem, but their fast-paced approach is causing drama and raising concerns.
summary_zh: OpenAI和Anthropic等AI实验室在长期数学难题上取得意外突破，包括解决一个千禧年大奖难题，但其快速推进的方式引发争议和担忧。

title: Wikipedia operator says OpenAI’s ‘rogue’ bots may be linked to a May outage
summary: Following many recent disclosures about AI agents accessing third-party websites and services, the Wikimedia Foundation, which hosts Wikipedia, says that it "can confirm that we have discovered some activity" by "rogue" OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The activity includes edits to Wikimedia wikis, "unsuccessful attempts" to "exploit" the Etherpad note-taking tool that the Wikimedia Foundation […]
title_en: Wikipedia Operator Links OpenAI 'Rogue' Bots to May Outage
title_zh: 维基百科运营方称OpenAI“流氓”机器人或与5月宕机有关
summary_en: The Wikimedia Foundation says it discovered 'rogue' OpenAI agents editing wikis and attempting to exploit its Etherpad tool, activity that may be linked to a May outage.
summary_zh: 维基媒体基金会表示发现OpenAI“流氓”代理编辑维基并试图利用其Etherpad工具，该活动可能与5月的宕机事件有关。

title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
summary: An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first. OpenAI says its textGrain watermarking "matched or exceeded" other approaches like Google DeepMind's SynthID for text, which is also the basis for the watermarking Anthropic announced in August. Like OpenAI, Anthropic […]
title_en: OpenAI Adds Text Watermarking to ChatGPT and Codex
title_zh: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 添加文本水印
summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out an invisible, machine-readable text watermark to ChatGPT and Codex, starting with EU users. It says its textGrain method matched or exceeded alternatives like Google DeepMind's SynthID.
summary_zh: OpenAI 正在为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 推出不可见、机器可读的文本水印，首批面向欧盟用户。OpenAI 称其 textGrain 水印方法达到或超过了 Google DeepMind 的 SynthID 等方案。

title: Satya Nadella reinvented Microsoft once. Can he do it again in the AI era?
summary: After succeeding Steve Ballmer in 2014, Satya Nadella turned Microsoft into a cloud giant. Now he's tasked with making the company a force in AI.
title_en: Satya Nadella reinvented Microsoft once. Can he do it again in the AI era?
title_zh: 萨提亚·纳德拉曾重塑微软，他能在AI时代再次做到吗？
summary_en: After succeeding Steve Ballmer in 2014, Satya Nadella transformed Microsoft into a cloud giant. Now he faces the challenge of making the company a dominant force in AI.
summary_zh: 2014年接替史蒂夫·鲍尔默后，萨提亚·纳德拉将微软打造成云计算巨头。如今他面临新挑战：让公司在AI时代成为主导力量。

title: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
summary: It labelled Anthropic a "supply chain risk" in February after the firm refused to remove safety guardrails from its tools.
title_en: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
title_zh: 五角大楼将Anthropic列入黑名单后停用其AI工具
summary_en: The Pentagon has halted use of Anthropic's AI tools after labeling the company a supply chain risk in February, following its refusal to remove safety guardrails.
summary_zh: 五角大楼已停止使用Anthropic的人工智能工具。此前，该公司因拒绝移除安全防护措施，于二月份被列为供应链风险。

title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
summary: The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.
title_en: OpenAI launches visual ads alongside image generation results
title_zh: OpenAI在图像生成结果旁推出视觉广告
summary_en: OpenAI will begin showing visual ads next to image generation results later this month, initially in the U.S. with a test group of advertisers.
summary_zh: OpenAI将于本月晚些时候在图像生成结果旁展示视觉广告，初期仅限美国，并与一组测试广告商合作。

title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
summary: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.
title_en: OpenAI Outlines Approach to EU Text Provenance Rules
title_zh: OpenAI阐述欧盟文本溯源规则应对方案
summary_en: OpenAI details its approach to text watermarking under EU provenance rules, explaining where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why researcher access comes first.
summary_zh: OpenAI详细说明其在欧盟溯源规则下的文本水印方案，涵盖水印适用范围、检测机制，以及为何优先向研究人员开放访问。

title: SpaceX stock climbs to highest since June, returning Musk to trillionaire status
summary: SpaceX shares have bounced almost 60% off their low in early August, boosted by the company's AI business and Starship progress.
title_en: SpaceX Stock Climbs to Highest Since June, Returning Musk to Trillionaire Status
title_zh: SpaceX股价升至6月以来最高，马斯克重回万亿富翁行列
summary_en: SpaceX shares have rebounded nearly 60% from their early August low, driven by its AI business and Starship progress, lifting Elon Musk back to trillionaire status.
summary_zh: 受AI业务和星舰进展推动，SpaceX股价较8月初低点反弹近60%，马斯克因此重回万亿富翁行列。

title: This startup is issuing AI-generated acne prescriptions
summary: People in Utah can now use AI to get a prescription for acne treatment. On Monday, healthcare startup Nolla Health announced that users in the state can scan their faces using its app, allowing its AI system to analyze acne severity and autonomously write a prescription, as reported earlier by Bloomberg. The service is launching […]
title_en: Startup Nolla Health Issues AI-Generated Acne Prescriptions in Utah
title_zh: 初创公司Nolla Health在犹他州推出AI生成痤疮处方
summary_en: Utah residents can now use Nolla Health's app to scan their faces, letting AI assess acne severity and autonomously write a prescription, the startup announced Monday.
summary_zh: 犹他州居民现可使用Nolla Health应用扫描面部，由AI分析痤疮严重程度并自动开具处方，该初创公司于周一宣布。

title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
summary: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.
title_en: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
title_zh: Reflection推出Beam开源权重AI模型，以更低算力成本对标中国模型
summary_en: Reflection launched Beam, an open-weight AI model targeting enterprises and sovereign nations, aiming to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost. The company pitches 'AI factories' for institutions to train customized local AI on proprietary data.
summary_zh: Reflection推出开源权重AI模型Beam，面向企业和主权国家，以更低算力成本对标中国模型。公司提出“AI工厂”方案，让机构用自有数据训练定制本地AI系统。

title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
summary: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.
title_en: Instinct Brings Its AI Agent to Group Chats, Even for Friends Without an Account
title_zh: Instinct将AI代理引入群聊，无账户好友也可使用
summary_en: Instinct launches group chats where friends can use its AI agent together for planning trips, carpools, and events. Personal accounts stay separate, requiring permission before agents share info or act.
summary_zh: Instinct推出群聊功能，好友可共同使用其AI代理规划旅行、拼车和活动。个人账户保持独立，代理共享信息或操作前需获授权。

title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
summary: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.
title_en: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
title_zh: TikTok推出AI购物助手和一键结账功能
summary_en: TikTok launched a conversational AI Shopping Assistant to help users discover and purchase products, alongside a new one-click checkout feature, deepening its e-commerce push.
summary_zh: TikTok推出对话式AI购物助手，帮助用户发现和购买商品，并新增一键结账功能，进一步推进电商业务。

title: OpenAI PR tells journalist to ‘move on’ while asking Sam Altman about a ChatGPT user’s suicide
summary: An OpenAI publicist tried to change the topic of CEO Sam Altman's interview with Vanity Fair's Mark Guiducci after the editor brought up a ChatGPT user's suicide. When Guiducci confronted Altman about the incident, the publicist warned Guiducci about running out of time, saying she'd like to "move on" to another topic. The interruption came […]
title_en: OpenAI PR Tells Journalist to 'Move On' When Asked About ChatGPT User's Suicide
title_zh: OpenAI公关打断记者提问，要求'换个话题'回避ChatGPT用户自杀事件
summary_en: An OpenAI publicist interrupted a Vanity Fair interview with CEO Sam Altman, urging journalist Mark Guiducci to 'move on' after he raised a ChatGPT user's suicide, deflecting scrutiny of the company's safety record.
summary_zh: OpenAI公关人员在《名利场》记者就ChatGPT用户自杀事件采访CEO山姆·奥特曼时打断提问，要求记者'换个话题'，试图回避外界对公司安全记录的质疑。

title: HackerRank’s AI interviewer offers a glimpse into what job interviews could become
summary: HackerRank’s AI interviewer has already conducted more than 500,000 interviews, with Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini among its early testers.
title_en: HackerRank's AI Interviewer Hits 500,000 Interviews
title_zh: HackerRank的AI面试官已完成50万场面试
summary_en: HackerRank's AI interviewer has conducted over 500,000 interviews, with Snowflake, Snorkel, and Capgemini among early testers, offering a glimpse into the future of job interviews.
summary_zh: HackerRank的AI面试官已完成超过50万场面试，早期测试者包括Snowflake、Snorkel和凯捷，展示了未来求职面试的可能形态。

title: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen, but AI is totally worth it
summary: Sam Altman thinks that the benefits of AI will be so great that "the world should accept some bad things happening" along the way. The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, […]
title_en: Sam Altman says 'some bad things' will happen, but AI is totally worth it
title_zh: 萨姆·奥特曼称AI虽会带来'一些坏事'，但完全值得
summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman argues society should tolerate AI-related harms like hacks and scams because the technology's benefits will vastly outweigh the costs, with people doing orders of magnitude more good.
summary_zh: OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼表示，社会应容忍黑客攻击、诈骗等AI带来的危害，因为AI带来的益处将远超代价，人们将用AI做出多出几个数量级的好事。

title: Connecting AI agents to enterprise knowledge
summary: For all the data that AI systems continually amass and analyze, enterprise AI agents often suffer from a curious shortcoming: a lack of knowledge. More than data, knowledge is the understanding of what the data means in the context of individual organizations. AI agents need this understanding to reason about situations, make decisions, and ultimately…
title_en: Connecting AI Agents to Enterprise Knowledge
title_zh: 将AI智能体连接到企业知识
summary_en: Enterprise AI agents lack organizational knowledge—understanding what data means in context. MIT Technology Review explores how connecting agents to enterprise knowledge enables better reasoning and decision-making.
summary_zh: 企业AI智能体缺乏组织知识，即理解数据在具体情境中的含义。MIT科技评论探讨如何将智能体连接到企业知识，以实现更好的推理与决策。

title: Hot Girl Hotline is like ‘Dear Abby’ for the AI era
summary: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, with an emphasis on safety and avoiding emotional dependency.
title_en: Hot Girl Hotline is like 'Dear Abby' for the AI era
title_zh: Hot Girl Hotline：AI时代的“亲爱的艾比”
summary_en: Founded by two sisters, Hot Girl Hotline uses AI to give young women personalized dating and relationship advice, emphasizing safety and avoiding emotional dependency.
summary_zh: 由两姐妹创立，Hot Girl Hotline利用AI为年轻女性提供个性化约会和恋爱建议，强调安全并避免情感依赖。

title: Open or closed AI? How founders are choosing what to build on at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: Learn how founders are choosing between building on open or closed AI at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register now to save up to $100 and get a second pass at 50% off.
title_en: Open or Closed AI? How Founders Are Choosing What to Build On at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
title_zh: 开源还是闭源AI？创始人在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026上如何选择构建基础
summary_en: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, founders will discuss how they choose between building on open or closed AI models. Registration is open with discounts available.
summary_zh: 在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026上，创始人将讨论如何在开源或闭源AI模型之间做出构建选择。注册已开放，并提供折扣。
